premises.text: People come to events to learn from great content and to socialize with people
premises.evidence_span: People come to events for two reasons. To learn from great content and to socialize with people.

premises.text: There is a demand for a product that combines learning and socializing in virtual events
premises.evidence_span: The world is missing a product that gives the two benefits of why we are all here at this event online.

premises.text: Users can interact in a virtual venue similar to a physical event
premises.evidence_span: You appear inside of that venue with hundreds of other people, just like it's here today.

premises.text: Communities can be brought together in a virtual space for events
premises.evidence_span: They have 2 million entrepreneurs across 600 cities, and no way to bring them together into the same room.

premises.text: Users stay engaged in the app for extended periods, similar to real events
premises.evidence_span: people are staying inside of our app, sometimes for 3-4 hours.

premises.text: The virtual events market has significant financial potential
premises.evidence_span: $62 billion are spent on event sponsorship alone.

premises.text: The business model includes charging organizations a monthly fee and taking a percentage of ticket sales
premises.evidence_span: we make money as a company is by charging organizations a monthly fee to have access to our venues.

value.text: Virtual events can effectively combine learning and socializing for users
value.evidence_span: The world is missing a product that gives the two benefits of why we are all here at this event online.
